title: Amazon launches TorchNeuron, an open-source framework that lets developers run PyTorch code on Amazon's Trainium chips with no rewriting needed, in public beta (Todd Bishop/GeekWire)
summary: Todd Bishop / GeekWire: Amazon launches TorchNeuron, an open-source framework that lets developers run PyTorch code on Amazon's Trainium chips with no rewriting needed, in public beta — A new software tool from Amazon aims to make switching from Nvidia to the company's own AI chips about as simple as changing a setting.
